verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's own site claims in-product AI agents that continuously surface insights and recommend next steps, along with AI trend-spotting across replays and heatmaps and AI summaries of replay playlists. That covers both the insights and the suggestions in the story. The MCP server only serves external assistants, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs for the in-product AI agents or insights feature (evidence is homepage marketing only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Agents monitor your product continuously, surface insights before you think to ask, and tell your team exactly what to do next.
Use AI to spot trends across hundreds of replays and heatmaps
Diagnose what changed, and why, in seconds, delivered as a dashboard you and your team can keep working from.
